## FAQ

#### Can I install the textured grab bar on my fiberglass tub surround?

Yes! The textured grab bar is designed for secure installation on fiberglass or acrylic surrounds as well as ceramic tile, plaster or drywall.

#### How much weight will the grab bar support? Is it a true grab bar or only a stabilizer?

It is a sturdy metal grab bar providing additional stability and securely supporting up to 440 pounds of pressure.

#### Is the Vive textured grab bar installed with screws or with suction cups?

The Vive textured grab bar can only be installed with the included screws and wall anchors where appropriate.

#### Does the textured grab bar include screws for installing it?

Yes! The Vive textured grab bar includes six 2” screws and six wall anchors suitable for installing on most surfaces.

#### Should the textured metal grab bar be placed horizontally or vertically?

The Vive textured metal grab bar can be installed in any position, horizontally, vertically or diagonally for optimal support in the desired location.

#### Is the textured grab bar only for the bathroom?

No, the textured grab bar can be installed on any indoor wall surface where additional support is needed.

#### Is the stainless steel grab bar shiny?

The stainless steel grab bar features a brushed nickel finish with a knurled center section to provide a non-slip grip.

#### Does the stainless steel grab bar include flanges to hide the mounting hardware?

Yes! Each stainless steel grab bar includes decorative flanges that securely lock in place after installation for a clean, sleek appearance.

#### Is the metal grab bar rust proof for use in the shower?

Yes! The stainless steel grab bar is resistant to rust and corrosion for safe use in the bathtub or shower.

#### Will the Vive textured grab bar work in a tiled bathroom?

Yes! The Vive textured grab bar can safely be installed on ceramic tile.

#### Can I use the textured grab bar to pull myself up from sitting in the tub?

Yes, the Vive metal grab bar can be installed diagonally in most bathtubs for additional assistance in exiting the tub.

#### Does the textured grab bar have to be installed into a stud?

Ideally, the textured grab bar should have both ends installed into a stud, however, the grab bar can be safely installed with only one end attached to a stud. The set includes wall anchors for securing the opposite end of the grab bar to the wall when necessary.
